verdict.rationale: The firm has a dedicated, though combined, IP practice page that names patent work: "From strategy and filing to licensing and disputes, we turn patents into powerful business assets." That documents filing and strategy as a group-level practice, but only as a single marketing line with no further depth. missing for 10: explicit patent drafting/prosecution detail, portfolio-building methodology, named patent practitioners or a dedicated patent group page, and independent corroboration.
